defects.description: leftShoulder=-136 vs rightShoulder=-120 (16° asymmetry). Description says both hands up to grip doorframe above the head — implies symmetric grip. Geometry confirms: leftWrist y=1.326 vs rightWrist y=1.228 (0.098 vertical gap); leftWrist z=0.144 vs rightWrist z=0.247 (0.103 z-gap). Hands at different heights/depths.
leftShoulder=-136 is 46° past vertical (-90=overhead). Anatomically extreme. -110 is sufficient for hand-above-head doorframe grip.

regression_risk: low — single-pose 2-field shoulder reduction+symmetrization; arms remain overhead gripping position
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: leftShoulder/rightShoulder rotZ (mirrored sign for right). - = raise arm up/overhead. Computed FK at leftShoulder=-110, leftElbow=70: wrist at (-0.611, 1.182, 0.244), which is 0.30 above head (y=0.879) and slightly forward (z=0.244 vs head z=0.247). Matches hand-on-doorframe-above-head. Symmetric -110/-110 produces mirrored hand positions for both sides gripping doorframe. Original -136/-120 was asymmetric (16° diff) and overshoot past overhead. Plausibility flag for shoulder_sagittal_flexion is a known false-positive for overhead arms (degenerate projection).
